description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Web and domain checks] WHOIS-style domain lookup. Registration facts for a domain from the official registry RDAP service (successor to WHOIS): registered or not, registrar and IANA id, created / updated / expiry dates, age in days, days to expiry, EPP status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC. Personal contact data is never returned. Cached 24 h. ~0.5-3 s.

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. example.com (a URL or email address also works; the registrable domain is used)

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

name: domain_rdap

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: WHOIS / RDAP domain lookup: age, registrar, expiry ($0.002/call)
